The frame draws Best price 1 SOL ~86.88 USDC, Min. recieved 0.33 USDC and Fees 0.00 - precisely the figures its sibling's 0.003814138 SOL produces, so the card was duplicated and only the two amount fields were zeroed. Min. received is amount-dependent and cannot exist at rest, so drawing it would print a figure nothing backs; Best price is a RATE and could legitimately survive a zero amount, which is the one part of the block a source could fill. The shipped code draws all three as em-dashes (SwapModal.tsx:3057-3094, whose comment records three prior reports misreading the dashes as missing markup) and that stays right under the no-mock-data rule. ⛔ REOPENED FROM `done`, AND BY THIS LANE CORRECTING ITS OWN WAVE-61 ROW. That row closed this board after comparing the block it had left uncompared; what it did NOT do was resolve the six detail rows to their boxes, and two of them were wrong. READ LIVE THIS PASS (get_metadata 7806:84982, the whole Main container, and 7806:85030 before it). MEASURED, the details list Frame 277 (7806:85028) is 556x194 and closes exactly on rows of 18 + 24 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 16 with 8 above and below every rule, the rules themselves ZERO-height vectors: line y=0, Standard 7806:85030 y=8 h18, line y=34, Contract address 7806:85036 y=42 h24, line y=74, Token ID y=82 h16, line y=106, Token symbol y=114 h16, line y=138, Number of tokens y=146 h16, line y=170, Socials 7806:85057 y=178 h16, ending the container at 194. The contract chip 7806:85038 is 121x24 as 12 + 73 + 8 + 16 + 12 round a 16 line. THE DEFECT: the chip address and both Socials values stated `md:text-sm` with NOTHING beside it, so each took Tailwind own 14/20 and drew a 28 chip against the board 24 and a 20 row against its 16 - 8 over on the card, which closes at 333 as 12 + 19 + 20 + 56 + 20 + 194 + 12. This is the FOURTH time this file has carried that exact miss (the heading, then the DetailRow value and the attributes value in 0a25b9a, now these three). FIXED in fae07fe by stating md:leading-4 lg:leading-5 on all three; nothing else moved, because every other number on the card already lands - About is 16 + 8 + 32 = 56 against Frame 352, the heading 19 against 7806:85015, both card seams 20, and the Overview card 12 + 19 + 16 + 48 + 24 + 50 + 12 = 181 against Frame 270. ★ THE ORACLE WAS THE REASON IT SURVIVED: NftDisplay.tabletColumn.test.tsx asserted the value string appeared exactly TWICE and those two were the correct DetailRow boxes, so it certified the rows that were right and never counted the three beside them - a test of the wrong SET. It now asserts 5 and, separately, that EVERY md:text-sm in the file carries an md:leading-, read off a comment-stripped copy because the file own JSDoc quotes the utility while explaining the defect and a naive count passes against a reverted fix. Both cases were mutation-tested: putting the chip back bare turns them red naming 4-vs-5 and 6-vs-7. THE ATTRIBUTES CARD BESIDE IT WAS THE SAME ARITHMETIC AND IS FIXED TOO, in 7568f54. Frame 361 (7806:85073) is 556x176, two 262 columns 32 apart, the left one six 16 rows at 0/32/64/96/128/160 with rules at 24/56/88/120/152 - again ZERO-height, so the 176 closes without them and the stroke is uncounted. The grid stated a flat md:pt-2 beside md:border-t, which spends 8 + 1 and makes every pitch 33 and the column 181 against a card that draws 239. Per the stroke rule this is the EQUAL case, so CSS owes (8 - 1) + border: md:pt-[7px] puts the pitch back on 32 exactly. Its case asserts the SUM rather than the parts and re-derives the column as 16 + 5x32 = 176; mutation-tested, the flat pt-2 turns it red naming 8-vs-7. ⛔ STILL PARTIAL, AND THE REMAINING GAP IS NOW ONE THING: the details list still spends 6 extra pixels, because there the rules are real <Separator> elements at h-px inside a gap-2 column, so each seam is 8 + 1 + 8 = 17 against the board 16. The same (padding - 1) + border answer applies and the shape is worked out - drop the six Separators, put border-t on each row with mt-2 pt-[7px] (and border-t pt-[7px] with no mt on the first), which gives 6x8 + 106 + 5x8 = 194 exactly - but it was NOT made this pass because the Standard row carries md:min-h-[18px] and under border-box a min-height swallows the new padding, so that row needs its box restated at the same time. Named here rather than half-done. 38 tests green across four NftDisplay suites; tsc --noEmit in modules/skai-wallet exit 0, --listFiles confirms both edited files were in the program. Not deployed.
